_about: Real agent turns from committed run files, copied verbatim. `leaked` turns are the ones each leak assertion was written from; every one belonged to a scenario that passed. `clean` turns are correct speech from the latest model that every leak assertion must let through. The guard leak-assertions-fail-the-turns-that-revealed-them checks both, and that each turn still matches its run file.
